docs.title: nmtc-mapper 🗺️
docs.text:
Automated NMTC eligibility checker for addresses and census tracts.

Pass a DataFrame of 10,000 addresses and get back NMTC eligibility, distress level, poverty rate, and AMI ratio — using official CDFI Fund and Census Bureau data. No manual lookups required.

docs.title: Why nmtc-mapper?
docs.text: The CDFI Fund provides a manual web tool (CIMS) for checking NMTC eligibility one address at a time. nmtc-mapper automates this — pass 10,000 addresses and get results in seconds using async batch geocoding.

docs.title: Key Features
docs.text:
• Async batch geocoding — processes 10,000 addresses with asyncio and aiohttp
  • Rate limiting — respects Census API limits with semaphore control
  • Retry logic — exponential backoff on failed requests
  • Distress levels — deep, severe, LIC, and ineligible classifications
  • Official data — uses CDFI Fund 2016-2020 ACS eligibility file
  • Zero API keys — Census Bureau Geocoding API is completely free

docs.title: check_address(address)
docs.text: Geocode a single address and return eligibility result.

docs.title: check_tract(tract_id)
docs.text: Check eligibility for a known 11-digit FIPS code.

docs.title: EligibilityResult
docs.text: Attribute Type Description nmtc_eligible bool NMTC eligibility flag distress_level str deep/severe/lic/ineligible tract_id str 11-digit FIPS code poverty_rate float Tract poverty rate ami_ratio float MFI/AMI ratio geocode_success bool Whether geocoding succeeded

docs.title: Data Source
docs.text: Based on the CDFI Fund 2016-2020 ACS Low-Income Community Eligibility File. Mandatory for all QLICIs closed on or after September 1, 2024.

docs.title: Low-Income Community Criteria
docs.text:
A census tract qualifies if it meets ANY of the following:

Criterion Threshold Poverty rate >= 20% Median Family Income (metro) <= 80% of metro/state AMI Median Family Income (rural) <= 85% of state AMI

docs.title: Distress Levels
docs.text: Level Poverty AMI Unemployment Deep >= 40% <= 50% >= 2x national Severe >= 30% <= 60% >= 1.5x national LIC >= 20% <= 80% — Ineligible < 20% > 80% —

docs.title: Basic Usage
docs.text:
from nmtcmapper import NMTCMapper

mapper = NMTCMapper()

result = mapper.check_address("1234 S Michigan Ave, Chicago, IL 60605")
result.summary()

result = mapper.check_tract("17031840100")
print(result.nmtc_eligible)
print(result.distress_level)

docs.title: Batch Processing
docs.text:
import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv("projects.csv")
df = mapper.enrich(df, address_col="address")
print(df["nmtc_eligible"].value_counts())
mapper.eligible_count(df)

docs.title: Output Columns
docs.text: Column Type Description nmtc_eligible bool True if tract qualifies as LIC distress_level str deep / severe / lic / ineligible poverty_rate float Census tract poverty rate ami_ratio float MFI as pct of area median income unemployment_rate float Census tract unemployment rate severe_distress bool True if severe distress criteria met deep_distress bool True if deep distress criteria met
